## Known biases

Bare-earth model from 2013-14 lidar: buildings, grading, drainage and shoreline changes since then are absent. Water is hydro-flattened (a flat surface, here at -1.62 m), so water depth and channel shape are not terrain. Elevations are NAD83/NAVD88 metres; the tile CRS is EPSG:26918 (NAD83), the project CRS EPSG:32618 (WGS84); the two differ by about a metre at most and the numbers were used unchanged. Flight dates are a project range, not per-flight dates.
